text:
maya: Quick sync — found a handful of SDK edge cases breaking v2 responses when function-calling + streaming. Need triage before canary next week. TL;DR: 3 blocking, 2 medium.

jon: Can you list the 3 blocking? I can take the streaming one.

maya: 1) streaming + function_call → incomplete JSON blobs in callback (seen in node + python). stack traces in logs. 2) pagination token mismatch between v1/v2 types (base64 vs urlsafe). 3) header normalization for host-based routing causes 401s in Dedicated clusters.

sasha: I have a preliminary fix for (1) — PR 5842. Adds buffered flush + char-escape guard. Needs review + unit tests.

kevin: I'll pick up pagination token mismatch. Is it a schema change or parsing bug?

maya: Parsing bug. v2 sometimes returns padded base64; old parser treats it as urlsafe and fails. We should normalize on SDK side.

alexa: Docs/changelog entry ready? We need a migration note + changelog for the deprecation timeline.

maya: Yes, I'll draft. Ops asked: extend deprecation window to 60 days for enterprise — thoughts?

jon: 60d fine, but canary schedule needs bump. Ops/infra: @deploy-bot can we extend canary to 2 weeks?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary window extension request received. Runbook command: `/run canary extend --days 14`. Needs eng-sre approval.

sasha: :thumbsup: I can get PR 5842 reviews by EOD if someone runs the CI patch.

ci-bot: ci-bot: CI queued for PR 5842 — running unit + integration suites (est ~22m).

kevin: Opening a branch for the pagination fix. Will add a migration test that simulates old parser behavior.

maya: Ownership updated: kevin owns pagination token fix, sasha owns streaming fix, jon owns header normalization + canary checklist. I'll own migration docs + partner notification.

alexa: Also need SDK bumps for python/node/go. @jon can you list release artifacts?

jon: Artifacts: python wheel, node npm package, go module. Planning semver minor bump (v2.1.0) once PRs land. Need CHANGELOG + migration snippet in repo.

sasha: Note: streaming fix adds some buffering; perf micro-regression ~0.5ms/token in microbench. Add Redwood-obs flags to monitor in canary.

maya: Good call. Add token latency per-route metric in console. @kevin add alert threshold so rollback triggers if >5ms/token sustained.

kevin: Will add alert + a smoke test hitting Dedicated routing to reproduce header 401.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Scheduled canary start 2025-06-03 09:00 UTC. Duration requested: 14 days. Posting updates to #incidents on rollback.

jon: Quick question: do we pre-notify all API customers about v1 deprecation now or wait until canary finishes?

maya: We pre-notify partner accounts this week with a short advisory + migration steps. Full public deprecation notice only if canary is green.

alexa: Can I get the migration checklist? I'll coordinate support threads and copy.

maya: Draft checklist: https://go.redwood/docs/migration-v2-checklist (draft) — please add comments.

kevin: Add a specific note about token normalization in the SDK changelog; some self-hosted clients may need manual fixes.

sasha: CI green for PR 5842 — tests pass, ready to merge from my side.

ci-bot: ci-bot: CI passed for PR 5842. Merge allowed.

jon: I'll open PR for header normalization tonight and attach canary checklist items.

maya: Thanks everyone. Next async check-in Friday 10:30 PT. If any blocker lands earlier, ping #eng-oncall and tag me. :rocket:
